attempts.summary: Official HC-VX3 specs support a fixed-lens camcorder entry. Sensor stated as 1/2.5" MOS (1MOS), total 8570K, effective 8290K(16:9)/6170K(16:9) depending on REC FORMAT, still 8290K(16:9)/6220K(4:3). No published mm dimensions for sensor, so sizeMm must remain null. Lens: 4.12-98.9mm actual, 35mm equiv 25-600mm (16:9) / 28.9-693.7mm (16:9 alt) / 25-600mm still 16:9 / 30.6-734.4mm (4:3); aperture F1.8-F4.0; 24x optical; 62mm filter. Weight: 433 g body (without lens hood, battery, SD card) and 484 g operating with lens hood + supplied battery + SD card. Image stabilizer is optical hybrid OIS with OIS Lock; this is NOT IBIS, so ibis should be null. Video: max 4K MP4 2160 at 72 Mbps VBR, MP4 1080/50M 50 Mbps, AVCHD 1080/60p 28 Mbps, 24p 2160/24p 72 Mbps; MPEG-4 AVC/H.264; AAC 2ch for MP4/4K MP4/24p, Dolby Audio 5.1ch or 2ch for AVCHD; no bitDepth/log/crop stated. LCD: 3.0" capacitive touch, approx 1840K dots (display area ~1550K at 16:9); mechanism (tilt/vari-angle) not stated in excerpts. Card slots: SD/SDHC/SDXC media supported; exact slot count/index not stated.
warnings: Not IBIS: official spec says Optical (Hybrid Optical Image Stabilizer, Optical Image Stabilizer Lock function). Do not populate ibis; leave null.
Sensor sizeMm must be null: only "1/2.5" MOS/1MOS" given, no published pixel pitch or dimensions. Do not convert 1/2.5" label to mm.

Source conflict: web page shows 4K MP4 effective pixels 8290K base and 6170K alt with same *1/*2 notes; PDF page 37 lists VX3 8290K/6170K but V900 6170K single value. Columns are interleaved in extracted text; verify which column belongs to HC-VX3.
Text extraction artifacts: '16.9)' vs '16:9)', '24k optical zoom', '4.12 mm to 98.9 mm', '1/2.5 z 1MOS' — OCR/encoding noise; confirm units/values against PDF directly.
35mm equivalent has REC FORMAT-dependent variants (*1/*2/*3 differ between web page notes and PDF note numbering). Do not collapse to a single focal range without noting conditions.

Weight configuration: 433 g explicitly excludes lens hood, battery, and SD card (integrated lens remains). 484 g is operating weight with lens hood + supplied battery + SD card. No battery-only or battery+internal-storage weight published; those bases must remain null.
LCD mechanism (fixed/tilt/vari-angle/multi-angle) not stated in supplied excerpts; touch and size/dots are.
Card slot count and per-slot index/media standards not stated; only supported SD/SDHC/SDXC media types.

Video: bitDepth, log profile, cropAtMax, chroma subsampling, fps per mode (beyond mode labels like 2160/24p, 1080/60p) are not published in excerpts; keep as notes with all codec/media/fps/chroma/internal/external conditions.
Power consumption and operating time not needed for camera facts but note the page 36 comparison table intermixes HC-VX3 and HC-V900 values; confirm correct column.
Model naming: help page title references HC-VX3K while specs header says HC-VX3; identity/scope to be confirmed by main reviewer.

attempts.summary: Panasonic AG-CX20 (cx20) public excerpts. Candidate facts: kind=interchangeable-lens camcorder? Actually integrated fixed lens (motorized 24x zoom), so fixedLens=true and mount=null; no mount image-circle inference. fixedLens: focalMin 4.12 mm, focalMax 98.9 mm (source typo '98.9 mmm'), 35mm equiv min 25.0 mm, max 600 mm, maxApertureWide F1.8, maxApertureTele F4.0, filter 62 mm. sensor format label '1/2.5-type MOS'; effectivePixels approx 8,290,000; sizeMm null (no published mm dimensions) — do not infer. OIS: 'Optical image stabilizer lens' + feature 'Ball O.I.S' = lens-shift OIS, not IBIS; ibis must be null. Weight: 0.85 kg main unit excluding handle unit, lens hood, battery, eye cup (not a clean bodyOnlyWeight since integrated lens stays but excludes handle unit); 1.5 kg including handle unit, lens hood, battery, eye cup — note this is not the battery-and-card basis. Body with integrated lens: base unclear, needs reviewer mapping. Recording media: SDHC 4–32 GB, SDXC >32–512 GB, microP2 (A/B series) with footnote; 2 slots. cardSlots: 2 slots, mixed media (SD + microP2) — slot-level mapping not supplied. Video: max resolution 3840x2160 up to 59.94p/50p; file formats P2/MOV/MP4/AVCHD; quantization P2 4:2:2 10bit (AVC-Intra100/LongG50/LongG25), 4:2:0 10bit AVC-Intra50, 4:2:0 8bit LongG12/LongG6 proxy; MOV 4:2:2 10bit or 4:2:0 10bit HEVC or 4:2:0 8bit; MP4 4:2:0 10bit HEVC/8bit; AVCHD 4:2:0 8bit. Super slow 1920x1080 120 fps (59.94 Hz)/100 fps (50 Hz). LCD: 3.5-inch touch (from features text); resolutionDots null; mechanism null (not stated). EVF OLED. Price out of scope.
warnings: Source typo: 'f=4.12 mm to 98.9 mmm' — treat as 98.9 mm but flag; do not silently correct without reviewer confirmation.

Weight 0.85 kg excludes handle unit, lens hood, battery AND eye cup — does not match 'bodyOnlyWeight' definition (which only excludes battery/cards); handle unit exclusion is an extra condition. 1.5 kg includes battery+eye cup+handle+lens hood; it is not clearly 'battery-and-card' basis (card inclusion unstated). Do not map either to a weight basis without reviewer decision.
No published sensor sizeMm; must be null — do not infer from 1/2.5-type label or lens image circle.
OIS confirmed (lens optical stabilizer/Ball O.I.S); IBIS must be null — do not promote OIS to IBIS.
microP2 support has footnote *2 unshown; availability conditions unknown.
cardSlots: two slots but per-slot media assignment (SD vs microP2) and standards per slot not itemized — cannot fully populate slots[] from supplied text.
Headline max recording mode (codec/bit depth/fps/chroma) requires the separate 'Recording Format' table, which is not supplied — representative max video cannot be finalized.
LCD resolutionDots and mechanism (fixed/tilt/vari-angle) not stated; only '3.5-inch touch' from features page — leave other LCD fields null.
'Optical image stabilizer lens' is in fixedLens/Lens section; it is lens-based, not sensor-shift.
Different model photos (HC-X2100) credited in features text; do not attribute X2100 specifics to CX20.

attempts.summary: Supplied x2 excerpts are contradictory/incomplete for several contract fields, so only candidate facts are reported; no code or edits. Identity candidates: product appears to be Panasonic HC-X2 (also referenced as X20 in one PDF header). Not established from these excerpts: body.kind (fixed vs interchangeable), mount (none stated), card slot index/media mapping beyond count=2, LCD mechanism, OIS vs IBIS classification, bitDepth/log/cropAtMax per exact recording mode. Focal/sensor candidates: PDF page 305 states pickup device 1.0-type MOS, total ~20,920,000 px, effective ~15,030,000 px; lens f=8.8-176mm, 35mm equiv 24.5-490mm, F2.8-F4.5, 67mm filter, 20x optical. The help-page table instead says sensor '1/5.8-type High Sensitivity MOS', total 1.5 MP, effective '15.03 megapixels', focal 8.8-176mm/24.5-490mm. Stabilisation: 'Ball O.I.S., 5-Axis HYBRID O.I.S.+ (UHD/FHD)' is lens/hybrid stabilisation wording in source, not established sensor-shift IBIS. Weight candidates: 2040 g main unit incl. grip belt excl. lens hood/battery/supplied accessories; 2490 g incl. lens hood, supplied battery, eye cup, 2 SD cards, mic holder, INPUT caps; PDF also lists 2000 g and 2430 g variants (likely a different model/variant within the same page). Media candidates: SDHC 4-32 GB, SDXC >32-128 GB, UHS-I, UHS Speed Class 3; 2 slots; relay/simultaneous/background recording, dual codec recording. Recording candidates: MOV (HEVC/AVC), MP4 (HEVC/AVC), AVCHD; UHD 3840x2160 up to 59.94p/50.00p; max bit rate candidate 200 Mbps (MOV HEVC LongGOP 200M and MOV 422ALL-I 200M); 10-bit 4:2:0 for HEVC, 10-bit 4:2:2 for MOV, 8-bit 4:2:0 for MP4/AVCHD. Log: V-Log latitude 13 stops claimed in help page only.
warnings: Identity conflict: help page names 'HC-X2' while PDF page header/file title says 'HCX2_X20_DVQP2766ZA'; confirm whether x2 and X20 are the same product or variants.

Sensor conflict: help page says '1/5.8-type' with total 1.5 MP; PDF p.305 says '1.0 type' MOS with total approx. 20.92 MP. Same effective ~15.03 MP is quoted in both, which is internally inconsistent with a 1/5.8-type sensor. Do not pick one without main-reviewer determination.
Effective pixels 15.03 MP exceeds the help page's stated 1.5 MP total pixels, so at least one source line is likely a typo or belongs to a different spec block.

Weight: source gives two/possibly four configurations (2040/2490 g and 2000/2430 g) without clearly separating models; contract requires weight plus exact configuration and bodyOnlyWeight excluding battery/cards. bodyOnlyWeight is not unambiguously derivable.
IBIS: '5-Axis HYBRID O.I.S.+' is lens/hybrid stabilisation wording; do not record as sensor/body-shift IBIS. ibis should be null unless the main reviewer confirms sensor-shift.
Mount/body.kind: no mount or interchangeable-lens statement appears in the excerpts; leave null/unestablished rather than inferring from the fixed zoom lens.
Do not infer sensor size in mm from '1.0 type' or from mount/image circle; no published sensor dimensions appear in the excerpts.

Recording mode/media conditions: max bit rate 200 Mbps appears only under specific codec/media/fps conditions (MOV HEVC LongGOP 200M, MOV 422ALL-I 200M), not as a universal maximum; all codec, media, fps, chroma, bit-depth, internal/output conditions must be kept as notes.
No cropAtMax or explicit log recording details (only a V-Log latitude claim) are established for the maximum mode.
LCD mechanism (fixed/tilt/vari-angle/multi-angle) and touch support are not stated; LCD presence/size ~3.5-inch and ~2,760,000 dots are candidates only.
cardSlots: count 2 is stated, but per-index media/standard mapping is not explicit; do not fabricate slot indexes.
Special modes (dual codec, super slow, VFR) must not be mixed into the representative max-video fact without conditions.
Price is outside scope and was not extracted.
Main reviewer retains authority over identity, scope, schema and application. No tools were available; no tests were run and none were claimed.

attempts.summary: An HC-X2 official excerpt conflicts with itself: the support web page lists Sensor as 1/5.8-type High Sensitivity MOS with Total Pixels 1.5 MP, while the official PDF manual (pages 304-308) lists Pickup device as 1.0 type MOS, total approx. 20,920,000 pixels, effective approx. 15,030,000. The web page's effective 15.03 MP plausibly belongs to the 1.0-type device, so the web sensor line is internally inconsistent. Shared: lens F2.8-F4.5, focal 8.8-176mm, 35mm equivalent 24.5-490mm, 20x zoom, 67mm filter. Stabilization is Ball O.I.S. plus 5-Axis HYBRID O.I.S.+; no sensor-shift IBIS is established. Weight: approx. 2040g main unit only (including grip belt) excluding lens hood, battery, supplied accessories; approx. 2490g including lens hood, supplied battery, eye cup, two SD cards, microphone holder, input terminal caps. PDF also lists approx. 2000g and approx. 2430g variants (paginated duplication or regional difference unclear). Dimensions 173x195x344mm including lens hood.
warnings: Web page says 1/5.8-type MOS; PDF says 1.0 type MOS.
Web Total Pixels 1.5 MP vs PDF approx. 20.92 MP; web Effective 15.03 MP matches PDF effective.
1/5.8-type and 15.03 effective MP are inconsistent with a 1.5 MP total; do not infer sensor mm.
No sensor-shift IBIS stated; O.I.S. and 5-Axis HYBRID O.I.S.+ are not IBIS.
PDF lists two weight/config sets (2040/2490g and 2000/2430g); basis of difference not explained in excerpts.
Manual's 2040g bodyOnlyWeight figure includes grip belt, excludes battery/cards/lens hood; integrated lens retained.

attempts.summary: Panasonic AJ-CX4000GJ (shoulder-mount broadcast camcorder). Candidate facts from excerpts: body.kind=interchangeable (B4 2/3-type bayonet mount). Fixed body weight ~3.4 kg (7.5 lbs), stated 'body only' — exact configuration not detailed (battery/cards not enumerated); treat weight basis as unknown/needs clarification. Pickup device: MOS x1, 11.14 million pixels — described as 'number of pixels'; effective megapixels not explicitly stated. No published sensor dimensions given. Lens mount 2/3-type bayonet, but no focal length/35mm-equivalent/aperture specs supplied: fixedLens fields not applicable to this interchangeable-mount body. Recording media: expressP2 x1 slot; microP2/SDXC UHS-II x2 slots; SDXC 32–128 GB UHS-I/II, UHS Speed Class 3, V90. Recording pixels: UHD 3840x2160, FHD 1920x1080, HD 1280x720, plus AVC-Intra50 1440x1080/960x720. Bit depth/chroma: P2 4:2:2 10-bit, 4:2:0 10-bit (AVC-Intra50), 4:2:0 8-bit (AVC-LongG12); MOV 4:2:2 10-bit, 4:2:0 8-bit, 4:2:0 10-bit (HEVC). Video compression: P2 AVC-Intra 422/LongG50/LongG25/LongG12 H.264 High Profile; AVC-Intra200/100/50 H.264 Intra Profile; MOV H.264 High Profile / H.265 HEVC Main10. Max representative mode: 4K (3840x2160) up to 59.94p/50p with HEVC 10-bit (per features); exact max-codec/fps/crop/log conditions not resolvable from excerpts. HDR: HLG/V-Log gamma. System frequency 59.94/50.00 Hz.
warnings: IBIS: excerpts do not explicitly establish sensor-shift/body-shift stabilization; ibis should be null unless the main reviewer confirms a body-shift statement elsewhere. No OIS/IBIS claim appears in these excerpts.
Sensor size: no published dimensions (sizeMm) present; do NOT infer from 2/3-type bayonet mount or image circle. format label also not given; leave unknown.
'11.14 million pixels' is stated as pixel count, not confirmed effective megapixels — flag before storing.
Weight: 'Approx 3.4 kg (body only)' — configuration (battery/cards) not enumerated; bodyOnlyWeight vs operating-weight basis ambiguous. Do not map to battery-and-card without confirmation.
Mount: 2/3-type bayonet indicates interchangeable B4 mount, not a fixed lens; do not populate fixedLens focal/35mm-equiv/aperture fields.
Recording mode conditions (codec/media/fps/chroma/internal-vs-SDI) are only partially specified; max-video bitDepth/log/cropAtMax cannot be firmly derived — keep as notes pending main reviewer.
No LCD sizeInches/resolutionDots/mechanism/touch details in these excerpts despite 'HD720p touch panel' feature mention; do not fabricate.
cardSlots: expressP2 x1 and microP2/SDXC x2 (3 slots) — confirm slot indexing/media mapping against full spec table.
